reason: Primary user-facing purpose is UI theming for DeepSeek Harness: the repository provides a web plugin that supplies selectable skins and exposes an Aurora/Paper/Hologram chooser in settings, with styling implemented through DSH token variables (`--dsw-alias-*`) rather than core code patches.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 网页端主题插件，提供 Aurora、Paper 和 Hologram 三套皮肤，并在设置里支持切换与回退系统外观，采用 `--dsw-alias-*` 变量进行样式覆盖。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides Aurora, Paper, and Hologram skins, letting users switch UI appearances in settings and revert to the system look while applying `--dsw-alias-*` token-based style overrides.

capabilities: Applies global CSS token overrides for UI colors in the DSH web client
Persists selected skin choice in localStorage
Adds/integrates a skin-selection option into DSH settings workflow

reasons.code: README explains the plugin is a set of three hand-tuned skins that only writes `--dsw-alias-*` custom properties on `<body>` for visual styling.
Package manifest declares a web client bundle with immediate injection (`platform: "web"`, `immediately: true`), confirming runtime execution in the browser UI.
Repository and install/use instructions describe adding the plugin to DSH profiles and enabling selection in Settings, indicating user-facing UI extension behavior.

capabilities: Applies global CSS token overrides for UI colors in the DSH web client
Persists selected skin choice in localStorage
Adds/integrates a skin-selection option into DSH settings workflow
